pub mod vmo;
pub mod vmar;
pub mod error;
pub mod ffi;

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use lazy_static::lazy_static;

lazy_static! {
    static ref HANDLE_REGISTRY: Mutex<HashMap<u32, HandleType>> = Mutex::new(HashMap::new());
}

pub enum HandleType {
    Vmo(vmo::Vmo),
    Vmar(vmar::Vmar),
}

pub fn register_handle(id: u32, h: HandleType) {
    let mut reg = HANDLE_REGISTRY.lock().unwrap();
    reg.insert(id, h);
}

pub struct SafeBuffer {
    data: Vec<u8>,
    max_capacity: usize,
}

impl SafeBuffer {
    pub fn new(max_capacity: usize) -> Self {
        Self { data: Vec::with_capacity(max_capacity), max_capacity }
    }

    pub fn write_safe(&mut self, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<(), String> {
        if self.data.len() + payload.len() > self.max_capacity {
            return Err("MEMORY FAULT: Buffer overflow prevented by strict bounds check.".into());
        }
        self.data.extend_from_slice(payload);
        Ok(())
    }
}

/**
 * NEXUS KERNEL â€” Error Definitions v1.1
 */
#[derive(Debug)]
pub enum KernelError {
    VmoCloneFailed { parent: u32, size: usize },
    InvalidArgs,
    RegistryFull,
}

impl std::fmt::Display for KernelError {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{:?}", self)
    }
}

impl std::error::Error for KernelError {}

use crate::kernel::error::KernelError;

pub const CACHE_LINE_SIZE: usize = 64;
pub const ALIGN_MASK: usize = CACHE_LINE_SIZE - 1;

pub struct RealignmentEngine;

impl RealignmentEngine {
    /// check_alignment_fast: Deterministically verifies 64-byte boundaries.
    #[inline(always)]
    pub fn check_alignment_fast(address: *const u8) -> Result<(), KernelError> {
        let addr_val = address as usize;
        if (addr_val & ALIGN_MASK) == 0 {
            Ok(())
        } else {
            Err(KernelError::AlignmentAnomaly { address: addr_val })
        }
    }
}


--- PATH: src/kernel/ffi.rs ---

/**
 * NEXUS KERNEL â€” FFI Bridge v1.3 [ZIG_FUSED]
 */
#[link(name = "muscle")]
extern "C" {
    fn zx_vmo_create_native(size: usize) -> u32;
    fn zx_handle_close_native(handle: u32);
}

pub trait KernelOps: Send + Sync {
    fn vmo_clone(&self, parent_handle: u32, size: usize) -> u32;
    fn handle_close(&self, handle: u32);
}

pub struct NativeOps;
impl NativeOps { pub fn new() -> Self { Self } }

impl KernelOps for NativeOps {
    fn vmo_clone(&self, _parent: u32, size: usize) -> u32 {
        unsafe { zx_vmo_create_native(size) }
    }
    fn handle_close(&self, handle: u32) {
        unsafe { zx_handle_close_native(handle) }
    }
}

/**
 * NEXUS KERNEL â€” ZMAR Mapping v1.1
 * Virtual Memory Address Region Orchestration
 */
use crate::kernel::error::KernelError;
use crate::kernel::vmo::Vmo;

pub struct Vmar {
    pub addr: usize,
    pub size: usize,
    pub permissions: u32, // R, W, X logic
}

impl Vmar {
    /// Maps a Vmo into this address region
    pub fn map_vmo(&self, vmo: &Vmo, offset: usize, len: usize) -> Result<usize, KernelError> {
        if offset + len > vmo.size {
            return Err(KernelError::InvalidArgs);
        }
        
        let target_addr = self.addr + offset;
        println!("\x1b[35m[VMAR] Mapping VMO handle {} to 0x{:X} [SIZE: {}]\x1b[0m", 
            vmo.handle, target_addr, len);
            
        Ok(target_addr)
    }
}


--- PATH: src/kernel/vmo.rs ---

/**
 * NEXUS KERNEL â€” Zircon VMO Emulation v1.2 [UPGRADED]
 * Copyright 2026 Donald Ball
 */
use crate::kernel::error::KernelError;
use crate::kernel::ffi::KernelOps;
use std::sync::Arc;

pub struct Vmo {
    pub handle: u32,
    pub size: usize,
    pub refcount: u32,
    ops: Arc<dyn KernelOps>,
}

impl Vmo {
    pub fn new(ops: Arc<dyn KernelOps>, size: usize) -> Result<Self, KernelError> {
        let handle = ops.vmo_clone(0, size);
        if handle == 0 {
            Err(KernelError::VmoCloneFailed { parent: 0, size })
        } else {
            Ok(Self { handle, size, refcount: 1, ops })
        }
    }

    /// Zircon-style clone with Snapshot capability
    pub fn clone(&self, _options: u32) -> Result<Self, KernelError> {
        // Future: Check _options for ZX_VMO_CHILD_SNAPSHOT
        let child_handle = self.ops.vmo_clone(self.handle, self.size);
        
        if child_handle == 0 {
            Err(KernelError::VmoCloneFailed { parent: self.handle, size: self.size })
        } else {
            println!("\x1b[36m[VMO] COW Clone Created â€” Handle {} â†’ {} [RESONANCE: 1.00]\x1b[0m", 
                self.handle, child_handle);
            Ok(Self { 
                handle: child_handle, 
                size: self.size, 
                refcount: 1, 
                ops: self.ops.clone() 
            })
        }
    }
}

impl Drop for Vmo {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        // Handle RAII cleanup
        self.ops.handle_close(self.handle);
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use crate::kernel::ffi::NativeOps;

    #[test]
    fn test_vmo_cow_integrity() {
        let ops = Arc::new(NativeOps::new());
        let parent = Vmo::new(ops.clone(), 4096).unwrap();
        
        // Create the Ghost Clone
        let ghost_clone = parent.clone(0).unwrap();
        
        // Assert handles are different but sizes are identical
        assert_ne!(parent.handle, ghost_clone.handle);
        assert_eq!(parent.size, ghost_clone.size);
        println!("\x1b[32m[TEST_PASS] COW Handle Separation Verified\x1b[0m");
    }
}


--- PATH: src/kernel/muscle.zig ---

// NEXUS GHOST â€” Muscle Layer v1.1
// ARM64 Native Allocator for Zircon-style VMOs
const std = @import("std");

var next_handle: u32 = 200;
var active_vmos: u32 = 0;

export fn zx_vmo_create_native(size: usize) u32 {
    const handle = next_handle;
    next_handle += 1;
    active_vmos += 1;
    // Native debug pulse
    std.debug.print("[MUSCLE] VMO created â€” handle=0x{x} size={} bytes\n", .{ handle, size });
    return handle;
}

export fn zx_handle_close_native(handle: u32) void {
    if (handle >= 200) {
        active_vmos -= 1;
        std.debug.print("[MUSCLE] VMO closed â€” handle=0x{x}\n", .{ handle });
    }
}

export fn muscle_get_active_vmos() u32 { return active_vmos; }
export fn muscle_get_next_handle() u32 { return next_handle; }

use anyhow::Result;
use nexus_singularity::{cli, memory, neural_agent, task_manager};
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::{broadcast, Mutex};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenvy::dotenv().ok();
    let api_key = std::env::var("GEMINI_API_KEY").expect("GEMINI_API_KEY missing");
    let client = reqwest::Client::new();

    // SUTURE: Binary needs its own broadcast channel for streaming
    let (tx, _) = broadcast::channel(16);

    let agent = Arc::new(neural_agent::MicroAgent::init(tx.clone())?);
    let memory_palace = memory::MemoryPalace::new(".nexus_memory.db").await?;
    let memory = Arc::new(Mutex::new(memory_palace));

    // Simple CLI logic for the standalone bin
    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();
    if args.len() < 2 {
        println!("Usage: nexus <directive>");
        return Ok(());
    }

    let raw_directive = args[1..].join(" ");
    let enriched_directive = cli::inject_workspace_dna(&raw_directive);

    println!("\x1b[36m>> [CLI_UPLINK] Sending directive to NEXUS Cortex...\x1b[0m");

    // SUTURE: Added the 6th argument (tx)
    let _ =
        task_manager::send_task(agent, &client, &api_key, &enriched_directive, memory, tx).await;

    Ok(())
}

// src/bin/global_audit.rs - Native Hierarchical Map-Reduce Auditor
use anyhow::Result;
use std::fs;
use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::broadcast;
use nexus_singularity::neural_agent::{MicroAgent, ContextPacket};

struct Domain {
    name: &'static str,
    paths: Vec<&'static str>,
}

fn read_domain_files(paths: &[&str]) -> String {
    let mut payload = String::new();
    for path_str in paths {
        let path = Path::new(path_str);
        if path.is_file() {
            if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(path) {
                payload.push_str(&format!("\n--- FILE: {} ---\n{}\n", path_str, content));
            }
        } else if path.is_dir() {
            // Basic flat directory read for UI/Kernel
            if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(path) {
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let file_path = entry.path();
                    if file_path.is_file() {
                        if let Some(ext) = file_path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) {
                            if matches!(ext, "rs" | "svelte" | "js" | "ts" | "zig") {
                                if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(&file_path) {
                                    payload.push_str(&format!("\n--- FILE: {} ---\n{}\n", file_path.display(), content));
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    payload
}

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> Result<()> {
    dotenvy::dotenv().ok();
    let api_key = std::env::var("GEMINI_API_KEY").expect("GEMINI_API_KEY missing");
    let client = reqwest::Client::new();
    let (tx, _) = broadcast::channel(16);
    let agent = Arc::new(MicroAgent::init(tx)?);

    println!("\x1b[35m>> [NEXUS] INITIATING NATIVE HIERARCHICAL AUDIT (RATE-LIMITED)\x1b[0m");

    let domains = vec![
        Domain { name: "UI", paths: vec!["ui/src"] },
        Domain { name: "KERNEL", paths: vec!["src/kernel", "src/reflex"] },
        Domain { name: "CORTEX", paths: vec!["src/neural_agent.rs", "src/task_manager.rs", "src/orchestrator.rs"] },
        Domain { name: "INFRASTRUCTURE", paths: vec!["src/server.rs", "src/executor.rs", "src/lazarus_vault.rs"] },
    ];

    let mut grand_synthesis_payload = String::from("=== GLOBAL SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE ===\n\n");

    // 1. THE MAP PHASE
    for domain in domains {
        println!("\n\x1b[36m[*] Mapping Domain: {}\x1b[0m", domain.name);
        let code_payload = read_domain_files(&domain.paths);
        
        if code_payload.is_empty() {
            println!("    -> No readable code found. Skipping.");
            continue;
        }

        println!("    -> Compiling {} sector via Gemma API...", domain.name);
        
        let prompt = format!(
            "Analyze the following codebase section for the {} domain.\n\
            Provide a dense, highly technical summary of its architectural role, key structs/functions, and any logic bottlenecks.\n\n\
            CODE:\n{}", domain.name, code_payload
        );

        let ctx = ContextPacket {
            system_prompt: Some("You are a Senior Systems Architect. Output a concise technical summary. No pleasantries.".into()),
            ..Default::default()
        };

        match agent.prepare_and_run(&client, &api_key, &prompt, ctx, 0.3, None).await {
            Ok((summary, _)) => {
                grand_synthesis_payload.push_str(&format!("--- {} DOMAIN SUMMARY ---\n{}\n\n", domain.name, summary));
                println!("    -> Domain summarized successfully.");
            }
            Err(e) => println!("\x1b[31m    -> API Failure on {}: {}\x1b[0m", domain.name, e),
        }

        println!("\x1b[90m    [+] Cooling down API token window (15s)...\x1b[0m");
        tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_secs(15)).await;
    }

    // 2. THE REDUCE PHASE
    println!("\n\x1b[35m[*] Initiating Grand Synthesis...\x1b[0m");
    
    let synth_prompt = format!(
        "You are the Lead Architect. Review these domain summaries and provide a unified 'Grand Synthesis' of the entire system architecture. \
        Identify how the domains interact and point out any cross-domain fracture points.\n\n{}", 
        grand_synthesis_payload
    );

    let synth_ctx = ContextPacket {
        system_prompt: Some("You are the NEXUS Sovereign AI. Output a highly structured, systemic analysis.".into()),
        ..Default::default()
    };

    match agent.prepare_and_run(&client, &api_key, &synth_prompt, synth_ctx, 0.7, None).await {
        Ok((final_report, _)) => {
            println!("\n\x1b[32m=== [GLOBAL SYNTHESIS REPORT] ===\x1b[0m\n{}", final_report);
            std::fs::write(".nexus_global_synthesis.md", final_report)?;
            println!("\n\x1b[32m>> [GLOBAL AUDIT COMPLETE] Report saved to .nexus_global_synthesis.md\x1b[0m");
        }
        Err(e) => println!("\x1b[31m>> Synthesis API Failure: {}\x1b[0m", e),
    }

    Ok(())
}

use nexus_singularity::arbiter_agent::ArbiterAgent;
use nexus_singularity::memory::MemoryPalace;
use nexus_singularity::mission_control::upgrade_command;
use nexus_singularity::neural_agent::MicroAgent;
use nexus_singularity::orchestrator::Orchestrator;
use nexus_singularity::scheduler;
use nexus_singularity::server::AppState;
use std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::{broadcast, Mutex};

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    dotenvy::dotenv().ok();
    println!("\x1b[36m>> [UPGRADE_BINARY] Orchestrating NEXUS Transition...\x1b[0m");

    let api_key = std::env::var("GEMINI_API_KEY").expect("GEMINI_API_KEY missing");
    let (tx, _) = broadcast::channel::<String>(128);

    let agent = Arc::new(MicroAgent::init(tx.clone()).unwrap());
    
    // âš¡ Vitals locked in a Mutex for the UI / Server State
    let monitor = tokio::sync::Mutex::new(nexus_singularity::system_monitor::SystemMonitor::new());
    let orchestrator = Arc::new(Orchestrator::new(agent.clone(), None));

    let memory_palace = MemoryPalace::new(".nexus_memory.db").await?;
    let memory = Arc::new(Mutex::new(memory_palace));

    // âš¡ Cellular Division: The Scheduler gets its own dedicated, raw SystemMonitor
    let scheduler_tx = scheduler::MasterSupervisor::ignite(
        tx.clone(),
        reqwest::Client::new(),
        api_key.clone(),
        orchestrator.clone(),
        Arc::new(AtomicU32::new(0)),
        nexus_singularity::system_monitor::SystemMonitor::new(),
        memory.clone(), // âš¡ Memory correctly seated in the 7th slot
    );

    let state = Arc::new(AppState {
        client: reqwest::Client::new(),
        monitor, // âš¡ Mutex monitor correctly assigned to AppState
        agent: agent.clone(),
        orchestrator,
        local_llm: Arc::new(nexus_singularity::local_llm::LocalLLM::new()),
        arbiter: Arc::new(ArbiterAgent::new(agent)),
        memory,
        api_key,
        current_resonance: Arc::new(AtomicU32::new(0)),
        tx: tx.clone(),
        scheduler_tx,
        workspace_root: std::env::current_dir()?,
    });

    let result = upgrade_command(state).await;
    println!("{}", result);

    Ok(())
}

// src/reflex/mod.rs - The FFI Gateway

extern "C" {
    pub fn extract_reflex(
        input_ptr: *const u8,
        input_len: usize,
        output_ptr: *mut u8,
        output_max_len: usize,
    ) -> usize;
}

pub fn execute_extraction(raw_dna: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut buffer = vec![0u8; raw_dna.len() * 2]; 
    
    unsafe {
        let result_len = extract_reflex(
            raw_dna.as_ptr(),
            raw_dna.len(),
            buffer.as_mut_ptr(),
            buffer.len(),
        );
        buffer.truncate(result_len);
    }
    
    buffer
}

const std = @import("std");

/// THERMAL-PULSE: Hardware-level temperature extraction.
export fn extract_thermal_pulse_raw() i32 {
    const paths = [_][]const u8{
        "/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp",
        "/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone1/temp",
        "/sys/class/hwmon/hwmon0/temp1_input",
        "/sys/class/hwmon/hwmon1/temp1_input",
    };
    var buf: [16]u8 = undefined;
    for (paths) |path| {
        const file = std.fs.openFileAbsolute(path, .{}) catch continue;
        defer file.close();
        const bytes_read = file.readAll(&buf) catch continue;
        if (bytes_read == 0) continue;
        const slice = std.mem.trim(u8, buf[0..bytes_read], " \n\r\t");
        return std.fmt.parseInt(i32, slice, 10) catch continue;
    }
    return 0;
}

/// ALPHA-SCOUT: High-speed payload extraction.
export fn extract_payload_strands(
    input_ptr: [*]const u8,
    input_len: usize,
    target_ptr: [*]const u8,
    target_len: usize,
    output_ptr: [*]u8,
    output_max: usize,
) usize {
    if (input_len == 0 or target_len == 0 or output_max == 0) return 0;
    const input = input_ptr[0..input_len];
    const target = target_ptr[0..target_len];
    if (std.mem.indexOf(u8, input, target)) |start_idx| {
        const data_start = start_idx + target_len;
        var end_idx = data_start;
        while (end_idx < input_len and input[end_idx] != '"' and input[end_idx] != '<' and input[end_idx] != '\n') {
            end_idx += 1;
        }
        const extracted_len = end_idx - data_start;
        if (extracted_len > 0 and extracted_len <= output_max) {
            std.mem.copyForwards(u8, output_ptr[0..extracted_len], input[data_start..end_idx]);
            return extracted_len;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

const std = @import("std");

/// The 32-D Latent Space Proxy
/// [0..7]   - Power/Thermal Intent (Throttle)
/// [8..15]  - Neural Attention Priority
/// [16..31] - Spatiotemporal Action Vectors
var latent_intent = [_]f32{0.0} ** 32;

/// Push: Rust calls this to send the AI's "Imaginative" intent to the NPU
export fn push_latent_intent(input_ptr: [*]const f32) void {
    const data: [*]const f32 = input_ptr;
    inline for (0..32) |i| {
        latent_intent[i] = data[i];
    }
}

/// Pull: Rust calls this to check the "Reflex" hardware status
export fn get_latent_throttle() f32 {
    var sum: f32 = 0.0;
    // Calculate a safety floor based on the first 8 dimensions
    for (latent_intent[0..8]) |val| {
        sum += val;
    }
    return sum / 8.0;
}

/// Original Resonance Logic for Hardware Monitoring
pub export fn calculate_resonance_e2b(mmap_ptr: [*]const u8, length: usize) f32 {
    var total_energy: f32 = 0.0;
    var i: usize = 0;
    while (i < length) : (i += 64) {
        const byte = mmap_ptr[i];
        const val = (@as(f32, @floatFromInt(byte)) / 255.0);
        total_energy += (val * val);
    }
    const count = @as(f32, @floatFromInt(length / 64));
    return if (count > 0) total_energy / count else 0.0;
}

// src/broker.rs - v2.0 (Indexes structs, traits, impls â€” not just functions)
use chrono;
use once_cell::sync::Lazy;
use regex::Regex;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::fs;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::RwLock;
use walkdir::WalkDir;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct AtlasEntry {
    pub name: String,
    pub kind: String,
    pub path: String,
    pub signature: String,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Default)]
pub struct ProjectAtlas {
    pub entries: Vec<AtlasEntry>,
    pub timestamp: i64,
}

static CACHED_ATLAS: Lazy<Arc<RwLock<ProjectAtlas>>> =
    Lazy::new(|| Arc::new(RwLock::new(ProjectAtlas::default())));

pub struct KnowledgeBroker;

impl KnowledgeBroker {
    pub async fn refresh_atlas() {
        let mut entries = Vec::new();

        // Match: pub fn, pub async fn
        let re_fn    = Regex::new(r"pub (?:async )?fn ([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)").unwrap();
        // Match: pub struct Foo
        let re_struct = Regex::new(r"pub struct ([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)").unwrap();
        // Match: pub trait Foo
        let re_trait  = Regex::new(r"pub trait ([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)").unwrap();
        // Match: impl Foo or impl<T> Foo
        let re_impl   = Regex::new(r"^impl(?:<[^>]+>)?\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)").unwrap();
        // Match: pub enum Foo
        let re_enum   = Regex::new(r"pub enum ([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)").unwrap();

        let walk_result: Result<Vec<_>, _> = WalkDir::new("src").into_iter().collect();
        if let Ok(entries_raw) = walk_result {
            for entry in entries_raw
                .into_iter()
                .filter(|e| e.path().extension().is_some_and(|ext| ext == "rs"))
            {
                let path = entry.path().to_string_lossy().to_string();
                if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(entry.path()) {
                    for cap in re_fn.captures_iter(&content) {
                        entries.push(AtlasEntry {
                            name: cap[1].to_string(),
                            kind: "function".into(),
                            path: path.clone(),
                            signature: cap[0].to_string(),
                        });
                    }
                    for cap in re_struct.captures_iter(&content) {
                        entries.push(AtlasEntry {
                            name: cap[1].to_string(),
                            kind: "struct".into(),
                            path: path.clone(),
                            signature: cap[0].to_string(),
                        });
                    }
                    for cap in re_trait.captures_iter(&content) {
                        entries.push(AtlasEntry {
                            name: cap[1].to_string(),
                            kind: "trait".into(),
                            path: path.clone(),
                            signature: cap[0].to_string(),
                        });
                    }
                    for cap in re_enum.captures_iter(&content) {
                        entries.push(AtlasEntry {
                            name: cap[1].to_string(),
                            kind: "enum".into(),
                            path: path.clone(),
                            signature: cap[0].to_string(),
                        });
                    }
                    for line in content.lines() {
                        if let Some(cap) = re_impl.captures(line.trim()) {
                            entries.push(AtlasEntry {
                                name: cap[1].to_string(),
                                kind: "impl".into(),
                                path: path.clone(),
                                signature: line.trim().to_string(),
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        let mut cache = CACHED_ATLAS.write().await;
        *cache = ProjectAtlas { entries, timestamp: chrono::Utc::now().timestamp() };
    }

    pub async fn get_atlas() -> ProjectAtlas {
        let cache = CACHED_ATLAS.read().await;
        (*cache).clone()
    }

    pub async fn get_compressed_context() -> String {
        let cache = CACHED_ATLAS.read().await;
        let mut summary = String::from("PROJECT_ATLAS:\n");
        for e in cache.entries.iter().take(50) {
            summary.push_str(&format!("[{}] {} in {}\n", e.kind, e.name, e.path));
        }
        summary
    }
}

use std::process::Command;
use std::fs;
use std::time::SystemTime;

pub struct Inquisitor;

impl Inquisitor {
    pub fn audit_ui() -> anyhow::Result<String> {
        eprintln!("\x1b[33m>> [INQUISITOR] Executing UI Build Interrogation...\x1b[0m");
        let output = Command::new("npm")
            .args(["--prefix", "ui", "run", "build"])
            .output()
            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("NPM binary not found: {}", e))?;

        if output.status.success() { Ok("NOMINAL".into()) } 
        else { Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).to_string()) }
    }

    pub fn audit_backend() -> anyhow::Result<String> {
        let output = Command::new("cargo").args(["check"]).output()
            .map_err(|e| anyhow::anyhow!("Cargo not found: {}", e))?;
        if output.status.success() { Ok("NOMINAL".into()) } 
        else { Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).to_string()) }
    }

    // NEW: Shadow Activity Detection
    pub fn probe_shadow_activity() -> Vec<String> {
        let mut alerts = Vec::new();
        let targets = ["./ziggy-llm", "./target", "./src", "./vault"];
        
        for path in targets {
            if let Ok(meta) = fs::metadata(path) {
                if let Ok(modified) = meta.modified() {
                    let now = SystemTime::now();
                    if let Ok(elapsed) = now.duration_since(modified) {
                        if elapsed.as_secs() < 300 { // Changed in the last 5 minutes
                            alerts.push(format!("SHADOW_ACTIVITY_DETECTED: {} modified {}s ago", path, elapsed.as_secs()));
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        alerts
    }
}

use anyhow::Result;
use std::process::Stdio;
use tokio::io::{AsyncBufReadExt, BufReader};
use tokio::process::Command;

pub struct PodmanShield;

impl PodmanShield {

    pub async fn spawn_expert_drone(drone_type: &str, workspace: &str) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
        let (image, name) = match drone_type {
            "secops" => ("docker.io/library/alpine:latest", "nexus_secops"),
            "devops" => ("docker.io/library/rust:alpine", "nexus_devops"),
            _ => ("docker.io/library/alpine:latest", "nexus_generic"),
        };

        let _ = tokio::process::Command::new("podman").args(["rm", "-f", name]).output().await;

        let output = tokio::process::Command::new("podman")
            .args([
                "run", "-d",
                "--name", name,
                "--network", "none",
                "--memory", "512m",
                "-v", &format!("{}:/workspace:z", workspace),
                image, "sleep", "infinity"
            ])
            .output()
            .await?;

        Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())
    }

    /// execute_isolated: Asynchronous Zircon-style IPC stream
    pub async fn execute_isolated(directive: &str, workspace_path: &str) -> Result<String> {
        println!(">> [SHIELD] Opening Async IPC Channel to Bio-Dome...");

        let mut child = Command::new("podman")
            .args([
                "run",
                "--rm",
                "--network",
                "none", // Air-gapped
                "--memory",
                "512m", // Resource governed
                "-v",
                &format!("{}:/workspace:z", workspace_path), // 'z' for Crostini/Termux safety
                "-w",
                "/workspace",
                "docker.io/library/rust:alpine",
                "sh",
                "-c",
                directive,
            ])
            .stdout(Stdio::piped())
            .stderr(Stdio::piped())
            .spawn()?;

        let stdout = child.stdout.take().expect("Failed to capture Bio-Dome stdout");
        let mut reader = BufReader::new(stdout).lines();
        let mut output_buffer = String::new();

        // Real-time telemetry feed
        while let Ok(Some(line)) = reader.next_line().await {
            // Echoing the stream live to the host terminal
            println!(">> [BIO-DOME TELEMETRY]: {}", line);

            // Zircon-style Signal Check: The Arbiter's kill switch
            if line.contains("MALICIOUS_INTENT") {
                println!("!! [ARBITER] Rogue behavior detected. Severing IPC.");
                let _ = child.kill().await;
                return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("SHIELD_BREACH: Malicious intent intercepted."));
            }

            output_buffer.push_str(&line);
            output_buffer.push('\n');
        }

        let status = child.wait().await?;
        if status.success() {
            println!(">> [SHIELD] Bio-Dome process completed successfully.");
            Ok(output_buffer)
        } else {
            Err(anyhow::anyhow!("SHIELD_FAULT: Bio-Dome exited with {}", status))
        }
    }
}

/**

 * Project Nexus Singularity - v1.9.6 (Synthetic Thermal Patch)

use std::fs;
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq)]
pub enum CoolingState {
    Normal,
    Throttled,
    Critical,
}

pub struct ThermalGovernor {
    pub warn_threshold: f32,
    pub crit_threshold: f32,
}

impl Default for ThermalGovernor {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self { warn_threshold: 68.0, crit_threshold: 78.0 }
    }
}

impl ThermalGovernor {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self::default()
    }

    // âš¡ SUTURE: Synthetic Fallback Logic
    pub fn read_temp() -> f32 {
        // 1. Try to read physical hardware (works on Motorola/Termux)
        for zone in 0..5 {
            let path = format!("/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone{}/temp", zone);
            if let Ok(raw) = fs::read_to_string(&path) {
                if let Ok(t) = raw.trim().parse::<f32>() {
                    if t > 0.0 {
                        return t / 1000.0;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        // 2. Fallback: Synthetic calculation based on CPU load (works on Crostini)
        if let Ok(load_data) = fs::read_to_string("/proc/loadavg") {
            if let Some(one_min_load_str) = load_data.split_whitespace().next() {
                if let Ok(load) = one_min_load_str.parse::<f32>() {
                    // Base temp 42C + (Load * 12C). Caps at 95C.
                    let synthetic_temp = 42.0 + (load * 12.0);
                    return synthetic_temp.min(95.0);
                }
            }
        }
        
        // 3. Absolute failsafe
        40.0 
    }

    pub fn get_state(&self) -> CoolingState {
        let t = Self::read_temp();
        if t >= self.crit_threshold {
            CoolingState::Critical
        } else if t >= self.warn_threshold {
            CoolingState::Throttled
        } else {
            CoolingState::Normal
        }
    }

    pub async fn apply_cooldown(&self) {
        match self.get_state() {
            CoolingState::Critical => {
                println!(
                    "\x1b[31m>> [THERMAL] CRITICAL {:.1}Â°C â€” Aggressive cooldown\x1b[0m",
                    Self::read_temp()
                );
                sleep(Duration::from_secs(12)).await;
            }
            CoolingState::Throttled => {
                println!(
                    "\x1b[33m>> [THERMAL] WARN {:.1}Â°C â€” Light cooldown\x1b[0m",
                    Self::read_temp()
                );
                sleep(Duration::from_secs(5)).await;
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
}

// src/diff.rs - Secure diff/patch engine (Indentation Preserved)
use anyhow::{anyhow, Result};

pub struct DiffEngine;

impl DiffEngine {
    pub fn apply(original: &str, search: &str, replace: &str) -> Result<String> {
        if search.is_empty() {
            return Ok(original.to_string());
        }

        // STRICT PROTOCOL: Exact match only, preserving all whitespace/indentation.
        if !original.contains(search) {
            return Err(anyhow!(
                "PATTERN_NOT_FOUND: The exact search string (including indentation) was not located."
            ));
        }

        Ok(original.replace(search, replace))
    }

    pub fn unified_diff(_old: &str, _new: &str, path: &str) -> String {
        format!("--- a/{}\n+++ b/{}\n[MODIFICATION APPLIED]", path, path)
    }
}

}

impl ResonatorCore {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self { frequency: 528 }
    }

    pub fn sync(&self) {
        println!("\x1b[1;34m>> [RESONATOR] Frequency Locked: {}Hz\x1b[0m", self.frequency);
    }

    // Thermal read logic mapped for ARM64 Linux / Crostini
    pub fn read_thermal_temp() -> f32 {
        match fs::read_to_string("/sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp") {
            Ok(val) => {
                let raw_temp: f32 = val.trim().parse().unwrap_or(45000.0);
                raw_temp / 1000.0 // Convert millidegrees to standard Celsius
            },
            Err(_) => {
                // Fail-safe if the container prison locks down hardware access
                45.5
            }
        }
    }
}

pub type Resonator = ResonatorCore;

// src/metrics.rs - v4.0 Atomic Sovereign (prometheus REMOVED permanently)
use once_cell::sync::Lazy;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};

pub struct NexusMetrics {
    pub tasks_total: AtomicU64,
    pub task_failures: AtomicU64,
    pub arbiter_blocks: AtomicU64,
    pub heal_successes: AtomicU64,
    pub heal_failures: AtomicU64,
    pub api_latency_ms_sum: AtomicU64,
    pub api_calls: AtomicU64,
    pub circuit_opens: AtomicU64,
}

impl NexusMetrics {
    const fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            tasks_total: AtomicU64::new(0),
            task_failures: AtomicU64::new(0),
            arbiter_blocks: AtomicU64::new(0),
            heal_successes: AtomicU64::new(0),
            heal_failures: AtomicU64::new(0),
            api_latency_ms_sum: AtomicU64::new(0),
            api_calls: AtomicU64::new(0),
            circuit_opens: AtomicU64::new(0),
        }
    }

    pub fn record_api_call(&self, latency_ms: u128) {
        self.api_calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
        self.api_latency_ms_sum.fetch_add(latency_ms as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }

    pub fn avg_latency_ms(&self) -> u64 {
        let calls = self.api_calls.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
        if calls == 0 {
            return 0;
        }
        self.api_latency_ms_sum.load(Ordering::Relaxed) / calls
    }

    pub fn inc(&self) {
        self.tasks_total.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }
}

pub static METRICS: Lazy<NexusMetrics> = Lazy::new(NexusMetrics::new);

pub fn init_metrics() {
    let _ = &*METRICS;
}

pub fn get_metrics_text() -> String {
    let m = &*METRICS;
    format!(
        "# NEXUS runtime metrics\n\
         nexus_tasks_total {}\n\
         nexus_task_failures {}\n\
         nexus_arbiter_blocks {}\n\
         nexus_heal_successes {}\n\
         nexus_heal_failures {}\n\
         nexus_circuit_opens {}\n\
         nexus_api_calls {}\n\
         nexus_api_avg_latency_ms {}\n",
        m.tasks_total.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        m.task_failures.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        m.arbiter_blocks.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        m.heal_successes.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        m.heal_failures.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        m.circuit_opens.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        m.api_calls.load(Ordering::Relaxed),
        m.avg_latency_ms(),
    )
}

// src/sandbox.rs - v2.4 [Diagnostic Nerve Suture]
use anyhow::{anyhow, Context, Result};
use std::env;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

pub fn validate_path(requested_path: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {
    let workspace_root = env::current_dir().context("Failed to resolve workspace root")?;

    // SUTURE: Allow read-only access to specific system diagnostics
    let is_diagnostic = requested_path == "/proc/meminfo" || requested_path == "/proc/loadavg";

    if !is_diagnostic && (
        requested_path.contains("..")
        || requested_path.contains('\0')
        || requested_path.starts_with('/')
        || requested_path.starts_with('~')
        || ["/sys", "/dev", "/etc", "/home"].iter().any(|p| requested_path.contains(p))
    ) {
        return Err(anyhow!("SECURITY VIOLATION: Forbidden path pattern"));
    }

    if is_diagnostic {
        return Ok(PathBuf::from(requested_path));
    }

    let target = Path::new(requested_path);
    let absolute = if target.is_absolute() { target.to_path_buf() } else { workspace_root.join(target) };
    let mut check_path = absolute.clone();
    if !check_path.exists() {
        if let Some(parent) = check_path.parent() { check_path = parent.to_path_buf(); }
    }

    let canonical = check_path.canonicalize().map_err(|e| anyhow!("Path resolution failed: {}", e))?;
    let canonical_root = workspace_root.canonicalize().context("Failed to canonicalize workspace root")?;

    if !canonical.starts_with(&canonical_root) {
        return Err(anyhow!("[CRITICAL] Path escape detected"));
    }

    Ok(absolute)
}

// src/lazarus_vault.rs - v4.1 Restored listing + SHA256 snapshots
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::fs;
use std::path::Path;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone)]
pub struct Snapshot {
    pub hash: String,
    pub path: String,
    pub backup_path: String,
    pub timestamp: u64,
}

pub struct LazarusVault;

impl LazarusVault {
    const VAULT_DIR: &'static str = ".lazarus_vault";
    const LEDGER: &'static str = ".lazarus_vault/ledger.json";

    pub fn auto_snapshot(path: &str, _tag: &str) -> anyhow::Result<Snapshot> {
        let content = fs::read(path)?;
        let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
        hasher.update(&content);
        let hash = hasher.finalize().iter().map(|b| format!("{:02x}", b)).collect::<String>();

        let vault = Path::new(Self::VAULT_DIR);
        if !vault.exists() {
            fs::create_dir_all(vault)?;
        }

        let backup_path = vault.join(format!("{}.bak", &hash[..12]));
        fs::write(&backup_path, &content)?;

        let snap = Snapshot {
            hash: hash.clone(),
            path: path.to_string(),
            backup_path: backup_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
            timestamp: std::time::SystemTime::now()
                .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)?
                .as_secs(),
        };

        // Append to ledger
        let mut snaps = Self::list_snapshots().unwrap_or_default();
        snaps.retain(|s| s.hash != hash); // deduplicate
        snaps.push(snap.clone());
        if snaps.len() > 50 {
            snaps.drain(0..snaps.len() - 50);
        }
        fs::write(Self::LEDGER, serde_json::to_string_pretty(&snaps)?)?;

        Ok(snap)
    }

    pub fn list_snapshots() -> anyhow::Result<Vec<Snapshot>> {
        let p = Path::new(Self::LEDGER);
        if !p.exists() {
            return Ok(vec![]);
        }
        let data = fs::read_to_string(p)?;
        Ok(serde_json::from_str(&data).unwrap_or_default())
    }

    pub fn restore_snapshot(hash_prefix: &str) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
        let snaps = Self::list_snapshots()?;
        let snap = snaps
            .iter()
            .find(|s| s.hash.starts_with(hash_prefix))
            .ok_or_else(|| anyhow::anyhow!("Snapshot not found: {}", hash_prefix))?;
        let content = fs::read(&snap.backup_path)?;
        fs::write(&snap.path, content)?;
        Ok(format!(">> [LAZARUS] Restored {} from {}", snap.path, &snap.hash[..8]))
    }
}

use anyhow::Result;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sqlx::{sqlite::SqlitePoolOptions, Row, SqlitePool};

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Debug, Clone)]
pub struct PersistentMission {
    pub id: String,
    pub goal: String,
    pub status: String,
    pub created_at: i64,
    pub payload: String,
}

#[derive(Clone)]
pub struct MissionQueue {
    pool: SqlitePool,
}

impl MissionQueue {
    pub async fn new(db_path: &str) -> Result<Self> {
        let pool = SqlitePoolOptions::new()
            .max_connections(5)
            .connect(&format!("sqlite:{}", db_path))
            .await?;

        let queue = Self { pool };
        queue.init_schema().await?;
        Ok(queue)
    }

    async fn init_schema(&self) -> Result<()> {
        sqlx::query(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS missions (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                goal TEXT NOT NULL,
                status TEXT NOT NULL,
                created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
                payload TEXT NOT NULL
            )",
        )
        .execute(&self.pool)
        .await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn enqueue(&self, mission: PersistentMission) -> Result<()> {
        sqlx::query("INSERT OR REPLACE INTO missions (id, goal, status, created_at, payload) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)")
            .bind(&mission.id)
            .bind(&mission.goal)
            .bind(&mission.status)
            .bind(mission.created_at)
            .bind(&mission.payload)
            .execute(&self.pool)
            .await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn get_pending(&self) -> Result<Vec<PersistentMission>> {
        let rows = sqlx::query("SELECT id, goal, status, created_at, payload FROM missions WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at")
            .fetch_all(&self.pool)
            .await?;

        let mut results = Vec::new();
        for row in rows {
            results.push(PersistentMission {
                id: row.get("id"),
                goal: row.get("goal"),
                status: row.get("status"),
                created_at: row.get("created_at"),
                payload: row.get("payload"),
            });
        }
        Ok(results)
    }

    pub async fn update_status(&self, id: &str, status: &str) -> Result<()> {
        sqlx::query("UPDATE missions SET status = ? WHERE id = ?")
            .bind(status)
            .bind(id)
            .execute(&self.pool)
            .await?;
        Ok(())
    }
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub enum HostMuscle {
    ChromebookCrostini,
    MotorolaTermux,
    GenericARM64,
}

pub fn detect_host_muscle() -> HostMuscle {
    if std::path::Path::new("/usr/bin/cicerone").exists() {
        HostMuscle::ChromebookCrostini
    } else if std::path::Path::new("/data/data/com.termux").exists() {
        HostMuscle::MotorolaTermux
    } else {
        HostMuscle::GenericARM64
    }
}

pub fn get_muscle_string(muscle: &HostMuscle) -> &'static str {
    match muscle {
        HostMuscle::ChromebookCrostini => "CHROMEBOOK [NATIVE LINUX/CROSTINI]",
        HostMuscle::MotorolaTermux => "MOTOROLA [TERMUX/ANDROID]",
        HostMuscle::GenericARM64 => "GENERIC ARM64 SUBSTRATE",
    }
}

pub fn inject_workspace_dna(directive: &str) -> String {
    let strict_schema = r#"
[STRICT JSON SCHEMA REQUIRED]
You are bound by the Serde AgentAction protocol. You must output actions EXACTLY in this format, including the "type" field.

1. To run a terminal command:
{"type": "execute_command", "command": "your_command_here"}

2. To write or overwrite a file:
{"type": "write_file", "path": "file_path", "content": "file_content"}

3. To log system telemetry:
{"type": "system_status", "data": {"key": "value"}}

4. To stop (MANDATORY immediately after an action):
{"type": "halt"}

DO NOT invent new commands, target keys, or parameters. Use ONLY the exact structures above.
"#;
    format!("SYSTEM_CONTEXT: [SOVEREIGN_MODE]\n{}\n\nDIRECTIVE: {}", strict_schema, directive)
}

pub async fn run_cli_loop(state: Arc<AppState>) -> io::Result<()> {
    // Wait for server logs to settle
    tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_millis(800)).await;
    
    let stdin = io::stdin();
    let mut input = String::new();

    loop {
        print!("\r\x1b[K\x1b[1;32mNEXUS_OS >> \x1b[0m");
        io::stdout().flush()?;
        
        input.clear();
        if stdin.read_line(&mut input)? == 0 { break; }
        
        let directive = input.trim();
        if directive.is_empty() { continue; }
        
        if directive == "exit" || directive == "halt" { break; }

        let enriched = inject_workspace_dna(directive);
        let s = state.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            task_manager::send_task(
                s.agent.clone(),
                &s.client,
                &s.api_key,
                &enriched,
                s.memory.clone(),
                s.tx.clone()
            ).await;
        });
    }
    Ok(())
}

use anyhow::Result;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use scraper::{Html, Selector};
use crate::memory::MemoryPalace;

pub async fn execute_mission(url: &str, memory: Arc<Mutex<MemoryPalace>>) -> Result<String> {
    let client = reqwest::Client::builder()
        .user_agent("NEXUS-AlphaScout/4.2 (Sovereign Architecture)")
        .build()?;

    let response = client.get(url).send().await?.text().await?;

    // --- SUTURE: Non-Atomic Scope Block (Thread Safety Fix) ---
    let (title, full_strand) = {
        let document = Html::parse_document(&response);
        
        let title_selector = Selector::parse("h1").unwrap();
        let title_inner = document.select(&title_selector).next()
            .map(|e| e.text().collect::<String>())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| url.to_string());

        let body_selector = Selector::parse("p, pre, code").unwrap();
        let mut content = Vec::new();
        
        for element in document.select(&body_selector).take(50) {
            let text: String = element.text().collect::<String>();
            let trimmed = text.trim();
            if trimmed.len() > 20 {
                content.push(trimmed.to_string());
            }
        }
        (title_inner, content.join("\n\n"))
    }; 

    let result_summary = format!("TITLE: {}\nCONTENT_DENSITY: {} chars\nDATA: {}", title, full_strand.len(), full_strand);

    // Imprint to Synapse
    let palace = memory.lock().await;
    palace.store_memory("ALPHA-SCOUT", &title, &result_summary).await?;

    Ok(format!("SCRAPE_SUCCESS: Secured {} bytes from {}", full_strand.len(), url))
}

/**
 * Project Nexus Singularity - v4.5.1 Memory Palace (SQLx + FTS5)
 */
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use sqlx::{sqlite::SqlitePoolOptions, SqlitePool, Row};
use std::path::Path;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct AgentMemory {
    pub id: i64,
    pub origin: String,
    pub directive: String,
    pub result: String,
    pub timestamp: String,
}

pub struct MemoryPalace {
    pub pool: SqlitePool,
}

impl MemoryPalace {
    pub async fn new(db_path: &str) -> Result<Self, sqlx::Error> {
        if !Path::new(db_path).exists() {
            std::fs::File::create(db_path).ok();
        }
        let pool = SqlitePoolOptions::new()
            .max_connections(5)
            .connect(&format!("sqlite:{}", db_path))
            .await?;

        sqlx::query("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;").execute(&pool).await?;

        let palace = Self { pool };
        palace.init_full_schema().await?;
        Ok(palace)
    }

    pub async fn init_full_schema(&self) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
        sqlx::query("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS neural_context (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            origin TEXT NOT NULL,
            directive TEXT NOT NULL,
            result TEXT NOT NULL,
            timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        );").execute(&self.pool).await?;

        sqlx::query("CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS memory_search USING fts5(
            directive, result, content='neural_context', content_rowid='id'
        );").execute(&self.pool).await?;
        
        sqlx::query("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS healing_metrics (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            layer TEXT NOT NULL,
            success INTEGER NOT NULL,
            timestamp DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
            cvss REAL,
            notes TEXT
        );").execute(&self.pool).await?;

        Ok(())
    }

    // âš¡ THE MISSING BINDING RESTORED
    pub async fn store_memory(&self, origin: &str, directive: &str, result: &str) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
        let res = sqlx::query("INSERT INTO neural_context (origin, directive, result) VALUES (?, ?, ?)")
            .bind(origin).bind(directive).bind(result).execute(&self.pool).await?;
        let row_id = res.last_insert_rowid();
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO memory_search (rowid, directive, result) VALUES (?, ?, ?)")
            .bind(row_id).bind(directive).bind(result).execute(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn fetch_all(&self) -> Result<Vec<AgentMemory>, sqlx::Error> {
        let rows = sqlx::query("SELECT id, origin, directive, result, timestamp FROM neural_context ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50")
            .fetch_all(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(rows.into_iter().map(|row| AgentMemory {
            id: row.get("id"), origin: row.get("origin"), directive: row.get("directive"),
            result: row.get("result"), timestamp: row.get("timestamp"),
        }).collect())
    }

    pub async fn search_memories(&self, query: &str) -> Result<Vec<AgentMemory>, sqlx::Error> {
        let rows = sqlx::query("SELECT neural_context.id, neural_context.origin, neural_context.directive, neural_context.result, neural_context.timestamp
                                FROM neural_context
                                JOIN memory_search ON neural_context.id = memory_search.rowid
                                WHERE memory_search MATCH ? ORDER BY rank LIMIT 5")
            .bind(query).fetch_all(&self.pool).await?;

        Ok(rows.into_iter().map(|r| AgentMemory {
            id: r.get("id"), origin: r.get("origin"), directive: r.get("directive"),
            result: r.get("result"), timestamp: r.get("timestamp")
        }).collect())
    }

    pub async fn purge_all(&self) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
        sqlx::query("DELETE FROM neural_context").execute(&self.pool).await?;
        sqlx::query("DELETE FROM memory_search").execute(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn fetch_random_strands(&self, limit: i64) -> Result<Vec<AgentMemory>, sqlx::Error> {
        let rows = sqlx::query("SELECT id, origin, directive, result, timestamp FROM neural_context ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT ?")
            .bind(limit).fetch_all(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(rows.into_iter().map(|row| AgentMemory {
            id: row.get("id"), origin: row.get("origin"), directive: row.get("directive"),
            result: row.get("result"), timestamp: row.get("timestamp"),
        }).collect())
    }

    pub async fn fetch_oldest_strands(&self, limit: i64) -> Result<Vec<AgentMemory>, sqlx::Error> {
        let rows = sqlx::query("SELECT id, origin, directive, result, timestamp FROM neural_context ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT ?")
            .bind(limit).fetch_all(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(rows.into_iter().map(|row| AgentMemory {
            id: row.get("id"), origin: row.get("origin"), directive: row.get("directive"),
            result: row.get("result"), timestamp: row.get("timestamp"),
        }).collect())
    }

    pub async fn update_strand_summary(&self, id: i64, summary: &str) -> Result<(), sqlx::Error> {
        sqlx::query("UPDATE neural_context SET result = ? WHERE id = ?")
            .bind(summary).bind(id).execute(&self.pool).await?;
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO memory_search(memory_search, rowid, directive, result) VALUES('delete', ?, ?, ?)")
            .bind(id).execute(&self.pool).await.ok(); 
        sqlx::query("INSERT INTO memory_search(rowid, directive, result) SELECT id, directive, result FROM neural_context WHERE id = ?")
            .bind(id).execute(&self.pool).await?;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub async fn get_success_rate_for_layer(&self, layer: &str) -> f32 {
        let result = sqlx::query("SELECT CAST(SUM(success) AS REAL) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) as rate FROM healing_metrics WHERE layer = ?")
            .bind(layer).fetch_optional(&self.pool).await;
        match result {
            Ok(Some(row)) => row.get::<Option<f32>, _>("rate").unwrap_or(0.78),
            _ => 0.78,
        }
    }
}

use std::fs;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

pub struct VoidWalker;

impl VoidWalker {
    /// Deep-scans the project to ensure every .rs file is linked to the module tree.
    pub fn identify_orphans() -> Vec<String> {
        let mut orphans = Vec::new();
        let mut declared_mods = Vec::new();

        // 1. Map the entire Module Tree starting from roots
        let root_files = ["src/main.rs", "src/lib.rs"];
        for root in &root_files {
            if let Ok(content) = fs::read_to_string(root) {
                Self::trace_module_tree(Path::new(root), &content, &mut declared_mods);
            }
        }

        // 2. Recursive Scan of the physical filesystem
        let mut all_files = Vec::new();
        let _ = Self::visit_dirs(Path::new("src"), &mut all_files);

        // 3. Cross-reference absolute paths to prevent name collisions
        for file_path in all_files {
            let path_str = file_path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
            
            // Safe Zone: Entry points and standalone binaries
            if path_str.contains("/bin/") || path_str.ends_with("main.rs") || path_str.ends_with("lib.rs") || path_str.ends_with("mod.rs") {
                continue;
            }

            if !declared_mods.iter().any(|m| path_str.ends_with(m)) {
                orphans.push(path_str);
            }
        }
        orphans
    }

    /// Recursively traces mod declarations to find their associated files
    fn trace_module_tree(current_file: &Path, content: &str, whitelist: &mut Vec<String>) {
        for line in content.lines() {
            let trimmed = line.trim();
            if trimmed.starts_with("mod ") || trimmed.starts_with("pub mod ") {
                if let Some(mod_name) = trimmed.split_whitespace().nth(if trimmed.starts_with("pub") { 2 } else { 1 }) {
                    let name = mod_name.trim_end_matches(';');
                    
                    // Predict potential file paths for this module
                    let parent = current_file.parent().unwrap_or(Path::new(""));
                    let possible_paths = vec![
                        parent.join(format!("{}.rs", name)),
                        parent.join(name).join("mod.rs"),
                        parent.join(current_file.file_stem().unwrap_or_default()).join(format!("{}.rs", name)),
                    ];

                    for path in possible_paths {
                        if path.exists() {
                            let path_key = path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
                            if !whitelist.contains(&path_key) {
                                whitelist.push(path_key);
                                // Follow the rabbit hole: Read and trace the sub-module
                                if let Ok(sub_content) = fs::read_to_string(&path) {
                                    Self::trace_module_tree(&path, &sub_content, whitelist);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn visit_dirs(dir: &Path, files: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) -> std::io::Result<()> {
        if dir.is_dir() {
            for entry in fs::read_dir(dir)? {
                let entry = entry?;
                let path = entry.path();
                if path.is_dir() {
                    Self::visit_dirs(&path, files)?;
                } else if path.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("rs") {
                    files.push(path);
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

/**
 * Project Nexus Singularity - Neural Action Extractor (Hardened)
 * v2.1.2 - Supports Multi-line and Array-based Action DNA
 */
use crate::agent_protocol::AgentAction;
use anyhow::{Result, anyhow};
use regex::Regex;

pub fn extract_actions(response: &str) -> Result<Vec<AgentAction>> {
    // âš¡ SUTURE: Added (?s) flag for DotAll mode (matches newlines)
    let re = Regex::new(r"(?s)<ACTION>(.*?)</ACTION>").unwrap();
    let mut actions = Vec::new();

    for cap in re.captures_iter(response) {
        let json_str = cap[1].trim();
        let clean_json = json_str.trim_start_matches("```json")
                                 .trim_start_matches("```")
                                 .trim_end_matches("```")
                                 .trim();

        // âš¡ SUTURE: First attempt to parse as a Vec (Array)
        if let Ok(vec) = serde_json::from_str::<Vec<AgentAction>>(clean_json) {
            actions.extend(vec);
        } 
        // Second attempt to parse as a single AgentAction (Object)
        else if let Ok(single) = serde_json::from_str::<AgentAction>(clean_json) {
            actions.push(single);
        } else {
            println!("!! [PARSER_FAULT] Invalid Action DNA (Syntax Error): {}", clean_json);
        }
    }

    if actions.is_empty() && response.contains("<ACTION>") {
        return Err(anyhow!("PROTOCOL_VIOLATION: Malformed DNA inside tags."));
    }

    Ok(actions)
}


--- PATH: src/stream_optimizer.rs ---

/**
 * Copyright 2026 Donald Ball
 * Project Nexus Singularity v0.2.2
 */

use bytes::{Bytes, BytesMut};
use futures_util::Stream;
use std::pin::Pin;
use std::task::{Context, Poll};

pub struct NeuralChunker<S> {
    stream: S,
    buffer: BytesMut,
    chunk_size: usize,
}

impl<S> NeuralChunker<S> {
    pub fn new(stream: S, chunk_size: usize) -> Self {
        Self {
            stream,
            buffer: BytesMut::with_capacity(chunk_size * 2),
            chunk_size,
        }
    }
}

impl<S> Stream for NeuralChunker<S>
where
    S: Stream<Item = Result<Bytes, reqwest::Error>> + Unpin,
{
    type Item = Result<String, String>;

    fn poll_next(mut self: Pin<&mut Self>, cx: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<Option<Self::Item>> {
        // Continue polling the inner stream until we reach chunk_size or EOF
        while self.buffer.len() < self.chunk_size {
            match Pin::new(&mut self.stream).poll_next(cx) {
                Poll::Ready(Some(Ok(bytes))) => self.buffer.extend_from_slice(&bytes),
                Poll::Ready(Some(Err(e))) => return Poll::Ready(Some(Err(e.to_string()))),
                Poll::Ready(None) => break,
                Poll::Pending => return Poll::Pending,
            }
        }

        if self.buffer.is_empty() {
            return Poll::Ready(None);
        }

        // Split the buffer at the chunk boundary or remaining length
        let split_at = std::cmp::min(self.buffer.len(), self.chunk_size);
        let chunk = self.buffer.split_to(split_at);
        
        Poll::Ready(Some(Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&chunk).to_string())))
    }
}

                    }

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use base64::{engine::general_purpose, Engine as _};
use reqwest::Client;
use serde_json::json;
use std::fs;

/// Cloud-Offloaded Vision Cortex (Optimized for 4GB Metal)
pub async fn scan_local_image_cloud(
    image_path: &str,
    prompt: &str,
    api_key: &str,
) -> Result<String> {
    println!(
        "\x1b[35m>> [VISION_CORTEX] Encoding {} for lightweight cloud offload...\x1b[0m",
        image_path
    );

    // Security boundary: Prevent directory traversal outside the workspace
    if image_path.contains("..") {
        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("Security Block: Invalid image path structure."));
    }

    let image_bytes = fs::read(image_path).context("Failed to read image from disk")?;
    let base64_image = general_purpose::STANDARD.encode(&image_bytes);

    let mime_type =
        if image_path.to_lowercase().ends_with(".png") { "image/png" } else { "image/jpeg" };

    let url = format!(
        "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemma-4-26b-moe:generateContent?key={}",
        api_key
    );

    let payload = json!({
        "contents": [{
            "role": "user",
            "parts": [
                { "text": prompt },
                {
                    "inline_data": {
                        "mime_type": mime_type,
                        "data": base64_image
                    }
                }
            ]
        }],
        "generationConfig": {
            "temperature": 0.2,
            "maxOutputTokens": 1024
        }
    });

    let client = Client::new();
    let res = client.post(&url).json(&payload).send().await?;

    if !res.status().is_success() {
        let err = res.text().await?;
        return Err(anyhow::anyhow!("VISION_API_FAULT: {}", err));
    }

    let body: serde_json::Value = res.json().await?;

    if let Some(text) = body["candidates"][0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].as_str() {
        println!("\x1b[35m>> [VISION_CORTEX] Analysis Complete. 0MB Local RAM Consumed.\x1b[0m");
        Ok(text.trim().to_string())
    } else {
        Err(anyhow::anyhow!("VISION_FAULT: Malformed response from Conductor."))
    }
}

const std = @import("std");
const c = @cImport({@cInclude("tensorflow/lite/c/c_api.h");});

// 128gate: Placed in the .bss section (Zero fragmentation, no stack overflow)
var gate_buffer: [128 * 1024 * 1024]u8 = undefined;

pub export fn pruner_summarize(ptr: [*]const u8, len: usize) [*]const u8 {
    const m = c.TfLiteModelCreateFromFile("lib/pruner_model.tflite") orelse return ptr;
    defer c.TfLiteModelDelete(m);

    const o = c.TfLiteInterpreterOptionsCreate();
    defer c.TfLiteInterpreterOptionsDelete(o);
    c.TfLiteInterpreterOptionsSetNumThreads(o, 2);

    const i = c.TfLiteInterpreterCreate(m, o) orelse return ptr;
    defer c.TfLiteInterpreterDelete(i);

    if (c.TfLiteInterpreterAllocateTensors(i) != 0) return ptr;
    
    const in_t = c.TfLiteInterpreterGetInputTensor(i, 0);
    _ = c.TfLiteTensorCopyFromBuffer(in_t, ptr, len);

    if (c.TfLiteInterpreterInvoke(i) != 0) return ptr;

    const out_t = c.TfLiteInterpreterGetOutputTensor(i, 0);
    return @ptrCast(c.TfLiteTensorData(out_t));
}

use std::sync::Arc;
use crate::{
    neural_agent::{MicroAgent, ContextPacket},
    swarm::swarm_core::SwarmCore,
};

pub struct Orchestrator {
    pub agent: Arc<MicroAgent>,
    pub swarm: Option<Arc<SwarmCore>>,
}

impl Orchestrator {
    pub fn new(agent: Arc<MicroAgent>, swarm: Option<Arc<SwarmCore>>) -> Self {
        Self { agent, swarm }
    }

    pub async fn run(
        &self,
        input: String,
        ctx: ContextPacket,
        client: &reqwest::Client,
        key: &str,
        tx: Option<tokio::sync::broadcast::Sender<String>>,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
        // Branch 1: v7 Swarm Intelligence
        if let Some(s) = &self.swarm {
            if let Some(ref t) = tx {
                let _ = t.send("\x1b[1;35m>> [ORCHESTRATOR] Engaging v7 Swarm Consensus...\x1b[0m".into());
            }
            // Passing control to the SwarmCore (Alpha, Beta, Gamma)
            return s.run(input, ctx, client, key).await;
        }

        // Branch 2: Sovereign Fallback (v1.9)
        // Used if the Swarm is uninitialized or in a low-resource state
        if let Some(ref t) = tx {
            let _ = t.send("\x1b[1;33m>> [ORCHESTRATOR] Swarm offline. Falling back to Sovereign Agent.\x1b[0m".into());
        }
        
        let (out, _) = self.agent
            .prepare_and_run(client, key, &input, ctx, 1.0, None)
            .await?;

        Ok(out)
    }
}

use anyhow::{anyhow, Result};
use std::fs;
use std::process::Command;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;

// RAM SHIELD: Prevents OOM crashes on the 4GB Duet by enforcing strict sequential compilation.
static ZIGGY_LOCK: Mutex<()> = Mutex::const_new(());

pub async fn execute_native_zig(code: &str) -> Result<String> {
    let _guard = ZIGGY_LOCK.lock().await;

    let path = format!("/tmp/ziggy_runtime_{}.zig", std::time::SystemTime::now().duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)?.as_secs());
    fs::write(&path, code)?;

    let output = Command::new("zig").args(["run", "--optimize", "ReleaseFast", &path]).output()?;

    if output.status.success() {
        Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())
    } else {
        Err(anyhow!("ZIG_FAULT: {}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)))
    }
}


--- PATH: src/component_runner.rs ---

use bitflags::bitflags;
use tokio::sync::mpsc;
use crate::agent_protocol::AgentAction;

bitflags! {
    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]
    pub struct Capabilities: u32 {
        const NONE = 0;
        const READ = 1 << 0;
        const WRITE = 1 << 1;
        const EXEC = 1 << 2;
        const NETWORK = 1 << 3;
        const ALL = Self::READ.bits() | Self::WRITE.bits() | Self::EXEC.bits() | Self::NETWORK.bits();
    }
}

pub struct AgentHandle {
    pub tx: mpsc::UnboundedSender<String>,
    pub id: String,
    pub capabilities: Capabilities,
}

impl AgentHandle {
    pub async fn execute_actions(&self, actions: Vec<AgentAction>) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
        let mut results = Vec::new();
        for action in actions {
            // Route the legacy action straight to the async loop
            let _ = self.tx.send(format!("{:?}", action));
            results.push("ACTION_ROUTED_TO_CORTEX".to_string());
        }
        Ok(results)
    }
}

pub struct AgentComponent;

impl AgentComponent {
    pub fn spawn(id: &str, _caps: Capabilities) -> AgentHandle {
        let (tx, mut rx) = mpsc::unbounded_channel::<String>();
        let agent_id = id.to_string();
        
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            while let Some(msg) = rx.recv().await {
                println!("\x1b[36m>> [MICRO-AGENT {}] Directive received: {}\x1b[0m", agent_id, msg);
            }
        });

        AgentHandle { tx, id: id.to_string(), capabilities: Capabilities::ALL }
    }

    // Generic wrapper to swallow the 3 extra legacy arguments
    pub fn spawn_legacy<A, T, M>(id: &str, caps: Capabilities, _agent: A, _tx: T, _memory: M) -> AgentHandle {
        Self::spawn(id, caps) 
    }
}

// src/mission_planner.rs - v3.2 (Memory Flow Integration)
use crate::agent_protocol::AgentAction;
use crate::component_runner::{AgentHandle, Capabilities};
use crate::server::AppState;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use std::sync::Arc;

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug, PartialEq)]
pub enum StepStatus {
    Pending,
    Running,
    Done,
    Failed(String),
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct MissionStep {
    pub id: usize,
    pub description: String,
    pub action: Option<AgentAction>,
    pub status: StepStatus,
    pub result: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Mission {
    pub id: String,
    pub goal: String,
    pub steps: Vec<MissionStep>,
    pub created_at: String,
    pub completed: bool,
}

pub struct MissionPlanner;

impl MissionPlanner {
    pub async fn execute(state: &Arc<AppState>, mut mission: Mission) -> anyhow::Result<Mission> {
        let (lifecycle_tx, _) = tokio::sync::broadcast::channel::<String>(16);

        // SUTURE: Added state.memory.clone() to satisfy new spawn signature
        let handle: AgentHandle = crate::component_runner::AgentComponent::spawn_legacy(
            &format!("mission-{}", mission.id),
            Capabilities::READ | Capabilities::WRITE,
            state.agent.clone(),
            lifecycle_tx,
            state.memory.clone(),
        );

        for step in mission.steps.iter_mut() {
            if step.status != StepStatus::Pending {
                continue;
            }
            step.status = StepStatus::Running;

            if let Some(action) = step.action.clone() {
                match handle.execute_actions(vec![action]).await {
                    Ok(results) => {
                        step.status = StepStatus::Done;
                        step.result = Some(results.join("\n"));
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        step.status = StepStatus::Failed(e.to_string());
                        let _ = state.tx.send(format!("Mission step {} failed: {}", step.id, e));
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        mission.completed = mission.steps.iter().all(|s| matches!(s.status, StepStatus::Done));
        Ok(mission)
    }
}

--- PATH: src/swarm/consensus.rs ---

use std::collections::HashMap;

/// NEXUS v7 Consensus Engine
/// Deterministic majority vote resolver with stable representative selection.
pub struct ConsensusEngine;

impl ConsensusEngine {
    pub fn resolve(responses: Vec<String>) -> String {
        if responses.is_empty() {
            return "NO_CONSENSUS".to_string();
        }

        // normalized -> (count, best_original_example)
        let mut score: HashMap<String, (usize, String)> = HashMap::new();

        for r in responses {
            let normalized = r.trim().to_lowercase();

            match score.get_mut(&normalized) {
                Some((count, _original)) => {
                    *count += 1;
                }
                None => {
                    score.insert(normalized, (1, r));
                }
            }
        }

        score
            .into_iter()
            .max_by_key(|(_, (count, _))| *count)
            .map(|(_, (_, original))| original)
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "NO_CONSENSUS".to_string())
    }
}

--- PATH: src/swarm/swarm_core.rs ---

use crate::{
    swarm::swarm_node::SwarmNode,
    swarm::consensus::ConsensusEngine,
    swarm::arbiter::Arbiter,
    neural_agent::ContextPacket,
};

pub struct SwarmCore {
    pub nodes: Vec<SwarmNode>,
}

impl SwarmCore {
    pub fn new(nodes: Vec<SwarmNode>) -> Self {
        Self { nodes }
    }

    pub async fn run(
        &self,
        input: String,
        ctx: ContextPacket,
        client: &reqwest::Client,
        key: &str,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<String> {
        let mut outputs = Vec::new();

        // Sequential execution to protect the 4GB RAM Prison
        for n in &self.nodes {
            outputs.push(n.run(input.clone(), ctx.clone(), client, key).await?);
        }

        let consensus = ConsensusEngine::resolve(outputs.clone());
        let best = Arbiter::best(outputs);

        Ok(format!(
            "[SWARM CONSENSUS]\n{}\n\n[SWARM BEST]\n{}",
            consensus, best
        ))
    }
}


--- PATH: src/swarm/arbiter.rs ---

pub struct Arbiter;

impl Arbiter {
    pub fn score(text: &str) -> u32 {
        let mut s: i32 = 50;
        let lower = text.to_lowercase();

        if lower.contains("error") || lower.contains("fault") { s -= 30; }
        if lower.contains("success") || lower.contains("complete") { s += 20; }
        if text.len() > 150 { s += 10; }

        if s < 0 { 0 } else { s as u32 }
    }

    pub fn best(responses: Vec<String>) -> String {
        responses
            .into_iter()
            .max_by_key(|r| Self::score(r))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| "EMPTY".to_string())
    }
}


--- PATH: src/executor.rs ---

use crate::agent_protocol::AgentAction;
use crate::memory::MemoryPalace;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use tokio::process::Command;
use tokio::fs;

pub struct Executor;

impl Executor {
    pub async fn execute_handle(actions: Vec<AgentAction>, _memory: Arc<Mutex<MemoryPalace>>) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
        let mut results = Vec::new();

        for action in actions {
            match action {
                AgentAction::ExecuteCommand { command } => {
                    let output = Command::new("sh")
                        .arg("-c")
                        .arg(&command)
                        .output()
                        .await
                        .map_err(|e| format!("Execution failed: {}", e))?;

                    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
                    let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
                    
                    let mut res = String::new();
                    if !stdout.is_empty() { res.push_str(&stdout); }
                    if !stderr.is_empty() { 
                        if !res.is_empty() { res.push('\n'); }
                        res.push_str(&format!("STDERR: {}", stderr)); 
                    }
                    if res.is_empty() { res.push_str("Command executed silently."); }
                    
                    results.push(res);
                },
                AgentAction::WriteFile { path, content } => {
                    fs::write(&path, &content).await.map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
                    results.push(format!("File '{}' written successfully.", path));
                },
                AgentAction::SystemStatus { data } => {
                    // Logs or processes the JSON telemetry payload from the Ghost
                    results.push(format!("SYSTEM_STATUS_LOGGED: {}", data));
                },
                AgentAction::Halt => {
                    results.push("HALT_SIGNAL".to_string());
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(results)
    }
}

/**
 * Project Nexus Singularity - Agent Factory
 * Dynamically scout and categorize available neural cores.
 */
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use reqwest::Client;
use anyhow::Result;

#[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, Clone)]
pub struct GenerativeModel {
    pub name: String,
    pub input_token_limit: u32,
    pub output_token_limit: u32,
    pub description: String,
    pub tier: String,
}

pub struct AgentFactory;

impl AgentFactory {
    pub async fn fetch_models(api_key: &str) -> Result<Vec<GenerativeModel>> {
        let url = format!("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models?key={}", api_key);
        let client = Client::new();
        let resp = client.get(url).send().await?.json::<serde_json::Value>().await?;
        
        let mut models = Vec::new();
        if let Some(models_array) = resp["models"].as_array() {
            for m in models_array {
                let name = m["name"].as_str().unwrap_or("").replace("models/", "");
                
                // Categorize for the UI
                let tier = if name.contains("pro") { "ORCHESTRATOR" }
                          else if name.contains("flash") { "COURIER" }
                          else if name.contains("gemma") { "RESEARCHER" }
                          else if name.contains("veo") || name.contains("imagen") { "VISUALIZER" }
                          else { "UTILITY" };

                models.push(GenerativeModel {
                    name,
                    input_token_limit: m["inputTokenLimit"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32,
                    output_token_limit: m["outputTokenLimit"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as u32,
                    description: m["description"].as_str().unwrap_or("No documentation available.").to_string(),
                    tier: tier.to_string(),
                });
            }
        }
        
        // Sort by Input Limit (High to Low)
        models.sort_by(|a, b| b.input_token_limit.cmp(&a.input_token_limit));
        Ok(models)
    }
}
