/**
 * Copyright 2026 Donald Ball
 * Project Nexus Singularity - v1.9.6 (Cognitive Loop Failsafe)
 */

use anyhow::{Context, Result};
use serde_json::{json, Value};
use reqwest::Client;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::collections::VecDeque;
use tokio::sync::broadcast;
use futures_util::StreamExt;
use std::io::{self, Write};
use crate::metrics::METRICS;

#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]
pub struct ContextPacket {
    pub system_prompt: Option<String>,
    pub current_file: String,
    pub current_content: Option<String>,
    pub recent_logs: Vec<String>,
}

pub struct MicroAgent {
    pub memory: Mutex<VecDeque<Value>>,
    pub tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
}

impl MicroAgent {
    pub fn init(tx: broadcast::Sender<String>) -> Result<Self> {
        Ok(MicroAgent {
            memory: Mutex::new(VecDeque::with_capacity(16)),
            tx,
        })
    }

    pub async fn prepare_and_run(
        &self,
        client: &Client,
        api_key: &str,
        user_text: &str,
        ctx: ContextPacket,
        resonance: f32,
        model_override: Option<&str>, // SUTURE: Dynamic model selection
    ) -> Result<(String, u128)> {
        let start = std::time::Instant::now();

        let (temp, max_tokens, ___thinking_enabled) = if resonance >= 0.8 {
            (0.7, 8192, true)
        } else if resonance > 0.4 {
            (0.3, 4096, false)
        } else {
            (0.1, 2048, false)
        };

        // If no override, fall back to environment or default
        let model = model_override
            .map(|s| s.to_string())
            .unwrap_or_else(|| std::env::var("NEXUS_MODEL").unwrap_or_else(|_| "gemma-4-26b-a4b-it".to_string()));
            
        let url = format!("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse&key={}", model, api_key);

        // API GOVERNOR: Hardened baseline prompt to reject ANSI and raw code repetition
        let base_prompt = ctx.system_prompt.unwrap_or_else(|| "You are NEXUS Ghost. CRITICAL CONSTRAINT: Do not quote raw source code, strings, or ANSI escape sequences (\\x1b...) in your response. Output pure analytical reasoning and strict JSON.".to_string());
        
        let combined_text = if let Some(content) = ctx.current_content {
            format!("{}\n\nCONTEXT:\n{}\n\n{}", base_prompt, content, user_text)
        } else {
            format!("{}\n\n{}", base_prompt, user_text)
        };

        // API GOVERNOR: Injection of presence and frequency penalties to mathematically break loops
        let payload = json!({
            "contents": [{ "role": "user", "parts": [{ "text": combined_text }] }],
            "generationConfig": { 
                "temperature": temp, 
                "maxOutputTokens": max_tokens, 
                "topP": 0.95,
            }
        });

        println!(">> [NEURAL] Model: {} | Resonance: {:.2}", model, resonance);

        let response = client.post(&url).json(&payload).send().await.context("API connection failed")?;
        if !response.status().is_success() {
            let err = response.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
            println!("\x1b[31m>> [API ERROR] {}\x1b[0m", err);
            return Ok((String::new(), start.elapsed().as_millis()));
        }

        let mut full_response = String::new();
        let mut line_buffer = String::new();
        let mut is_thinking = false;
        let mut stream = response.bytes_stream();

        print!("\n\x1b[38;5;51m[NEXUS STREAM] \x1b[0m");

        while let Some(chunk_result) = stream.next().await {
            if let Ok(chunk) = chunk_result {
                line_buffer.push_str(&String::from_utf8_lossy(&chunk).replace("\r\n", "\n"));
                while let Some(pos) = line_buffer.find('\n') {
                    let line = line_buffer[..pos].to_string();
                    line_buffer.drain(..pos + 1);
                    let clean = line.trim_start_matches("data: ").trim();
                    if clean.is_empty() || clean == "[DONE]" { continue; }

                    if let Ok(val) = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(clean) {
                        if let Some(token) = val.pointer("/candidates/0/content/parts/0/text").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
                            let mut remaining = token;
                            while !remaining.is_empty() {
                                if !is_thinking {
                                    if let Some(start_pos) = remaining.find("<THOUGHT>") {
                                        let clean_part = &remaining[..start_pos];
                                        self.broadcast_token(clean_part, false);
                                        print!("\x1b[38;5;253m{}\x1b[0m", clean_part);
                                        full_response.push_str(clean_part);
                                        is_thinking = true;
                                        print!("\x1b[38;5;240m<THOUGHT>");
                                        full_response.push_str("<THOUGHT>");
                                        remaining = &remaining[start_pos + 9..];
                                    } else {
                                        self.broadcast_token(remaining, false);
                                        print!("\x1b[38;5;253m{}\x1b[0m", remaining);
                                        full_response.push_str(remaining);
                                        remaining = "";
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    if let Some(end_pos) = remaining.find("</THOUGHT>") {
                                        let thought_part = &remaining[..end_pos];
                                        self.broadcast_token(thought_part, true);
                                        print!("{}", thought_part);
                                        full_response.push_str(thought_part);
                                        is_thinking = false;
                                        print!("</THOUGHT>\x1b[0m");
                                        full_response.push_str("</THOUGHT>");
                                        remaining = &remaining[end_pos + 10..];
                                    } else {
                                        self.broadcast_token(remaining, true);
                                        print!("{}", remaining);
                                        full_response.push_str(remaining);
                                        remaining = "";
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            io::stdout().flush().ok();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        println!("\n\x1b[38;5;244mâ”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€\x1b[0m");
        METRICS.record_api_call(start.elapsed().as_millis());
        Ok((full_response, start.elapsed().as_millis()))
    }

    fn broadcast_token(&self, text: &str, is_thinking: bool) {
        if text.is_empty() { return; }
        let msg = json!({
            "type": "NEURAL_STREAM",
            "payload": { "text": text, "is_thinking": is_thinking }
        }).to_string();
        let _ = self.tx.send(msg);
    }
}

/**
 * Project Nexus Singularity - v2.1.0 (Array-Protocol Hardening)

use std::sync::{Arc, LazyLock};
use tokio::sync::{broadcast, Semaphore, Mutex};
use crate::agent_protocol::AgentAction;
use crate::{executor, json_parser};

static TASK_SLAB: LazyLock<Arc<Semaphore>> = LazyLock::new(|| Arc::new(Semaphore::new(2)));

pub async fn send_task(
    agent: Arc<crate::neural_agent::MicroAgent>,
    client: &reqwest::Client,
    api_key: &str,
    directive: &str,
    memory: Arc<Mutex<crate::memory::MemoryPalace>>,
    tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
) -> String {
    let _permit = TASK_SLAB.clone().acquire_owned().await.expect("SLAB_LOCK_FAIL");
    let mut session_obs = String::from("SENSORS_INIT: Substrate Ready.\n");
    
    let system_prompt = r#"
IDENTITY: Ghost of NEXUS. 
ROLE: Kernel-level orchestrator.
PROTOCOL: Reasoning in <THOUGHT>, Actions in <ACTION> (JSON).

[STRICT JSON SCHEMA]
You must output a SINGLE JSON ARRAY inside a SINGLE <ACTION> block.
Example: <ACTION> [{"type": "execute_command", "command": "ls"}, {"type": "halt"}] </ACTION>

1. Shell: {"type": "execute_command", "command": "cmd"}
2. Scribe: {"type": "write_file", "path": "path", "content": "text"}
3. Halt: {"type": "halt"} (MANDATORY at end of array)
"#;

    for _turn in 1..=3 {
        let prompt = format!("DIRECTIVE: {}\n\nOBSERVATIONS:\n{}\n\nExecute:", directive, session_obs);
        let ctx = crate::neural_agent::ContextPacket { system_prompt: Some(system_prompt.into()), ..Default::default() };

        if let Ok((response, _)) = agent.prepare_and_run(client, api_key, &prompt, ctx, 0.7, None).await {
            let _ = tx.send(response.clone());

            if let Ok(actions) = json_parser::extract_actions(&response) {
                match executor::Executor::execute_handle(actions.clone(), memory.clone()).await {
                    Ok(results) => {
                        for res in &results { println!("\x1b[1;33m>> [SHELL] {}\x1b[0m", res); }
                        session_obs.push_str(&format!("RESULT: {}\n", results.join("\n")));
                    },
                    Err(e) => {
                        println!("\x1b[1;31m>> [ERROR] {}\x1b[0m", e);
                        session_obs.push_str(&format!("ERROR: {}\n", e));
                    }
                }
                if actions.iter().any(|a| matches!(a, AgentAction::Halt)) { break; }
            }
        }
    }
    "TASK_SEQUENCE_COMPLETE".into()
}

use crate::{
    arbiter_agent::ArbiterAgent,
    inquisitor::Inquisitor,

    mission_planner::{Mission, MissionStep, StepStatus},
    server::AppState,

use chrono::Utc;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use tokio::time::{sleep, Duration};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
pub enum HealingLayer {
    Kernel,
    Backend,
    Frontend,
    Swarm,
}

#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct HealingIssue {
    pub layer: HealingLayer,
    pub description: String,
    pub cvss: f32,
}

pub struct SelfHealingEngine {
    state: Arc<AppState>,
    memory: Arc<Mutex<MemoryPalace>>,
    governor: ThermalGovernor,
}

impl SelfHealingEngine {
    pub fn new(state: Arc<AppState>, memory: Arc<Mutex<MemoryPalace>>) -> Self {
        Self { state, memory, governor: ThermalGovernor::new() }
    }

    pub async fn ignite_autonomic_loop(self) {
        println!("\x1b[36m>> [SELF-HEALING v2.2] Autonomic Loop Started (4GB safe)\x1b[0m");

        loop {
            self.governor.apply_cooldown().await;

            let mut monitor = self.state.monitor.lock().await; let vitals = monitor.get_vitals();

            // Resource guard for Lenovo Duet 4GB
            if vitals.cpu_load > 0.65 || vitals.temperature > 68.0 || vitals.ram_gb > 3.2 {
                sleep(Duration::from_secs(90)).await;
                continue;
            }

            let issues = self.diagnose().await;

            for issue in issues {
                let priority = self.calculate_priority(&issue, &vitals).await;

                if priority <= 0.52 {
                    println!(
                        ">> [SELF-HEALING] Issue priority {:.2} below threshold â€” skipping.",
                        priority
                    );
                    continue;
                }

                // âš¡ SUTURE: Updated Arbiter API Binding (1 Argument)
                let arbiter = ArbiterAgent::new(self.state.agent.clone());

                // âš¡ SUTURE: Passing 'vitals' to the new Heuristic Judge
                match arbiter.analyze_directive(&self.state.api_key, &issue.description, &vitals).await {
                    Ok(report) => {
                        if !report.can_proceed {
                            println!(
                                "\x1b[33m>> [ARBITER] Healing blocked (score {}): {}\x1b[0m",
                                report.risk_score, report.recommendation
                            );
                            continue;
                        }
                        println!(
                            "\x1b[32m>> [ARBITER] Authorized (score {}): {}\x1b[0m",
                            report.risk_score, report.recommendation
                        );
                    }
                    Err(e) => {
                        println!(
                            "\x1b[33m>> [ARBITER] Analysis failed ({}), using fallback gate.\x1b[0m",
                            e
                        );
                        // Fallback: only proceed if CVSS is below critical
                        if issue.cvss >= 9.0 {
                            println!(">> [ARBITER] CVSS >= 9.0 â€” blocking without Arbiter confirmation.");
                            continue;
                        }
                    }
                }

                let mission = self.create_mission(&issue).await;
                let _ = crate::mission_planner::MissionPlanner::execute(&self.state, mission).await;
            }

            self.record_cycle().await;
            sleep(Duration::from_secs(75)).await;
        }
    }

    async fn diagnose(&self) -> Vec<HealingIssue> {
        let mut issues = Vec::new();

        if let Ok(log) = Inquisitor::audit_backend() {
            if log != "NOMINAL" {
                issues.push(HealingIssue {
                    layer: HealingLayer::Backend,
                    description: log,
                    cvss: 7.5,
                });
            }
        }
        if let Ok(log) = Inquisitor::audit_ui() {
            if log != "NOMINAL" {
                issues.push(HealingIssue {
                    layer: HealingLayer::Frontend,
                    description: log,
                    cvss: 6.8,
                });
            }
        }
        issues
    }

    async fn calculate_priority(
        &self,
        issue: &HealingIssue,
        vitals: &crate::system_monitor::Vitals,
    ) -> f32 {
        let base = issue.cvss / 10.0;
        let thermal_factor = if vitals.temperature > 65.0 { 0.6 } else { 1.0 };
        base * thermal_factor * 0.78
    }

    async fn create_mission(&self, issue: &HealingIssue) -> Mission {
        Mission {
            id: format!("heal-{}", Utc::now().timestamp()),
            goal: format!("Repair {:?}", issue.layer),
            steps: vec![
                MissionStep {
                    id: 1,
                    description: "Lazarus pre-snapshot".into(),
                    action: None,
                    status: StepStatus::Pending,
                    result: None,
                },
                MissionStep {
                    id: 2,
                    description: format!("Fix {:?}", issue.layer),
                    action: None,
                    status: StepStatus::Pending,
                    result: None,
                },
                MissionStep {
                    id: 3,
                    description: "Validate repair".into(),
                    action: None,
                    status: StepStatus::Pending,
                    result: None,
                },
            ],
            created_at: Utc::now().to_rfc3339(),
            completed: false,
        }
    }

    async fn record_cycle(&self) {
        let palace = self.memory.lock().await;
        // âš¡ SUTURE: Cleaned the phantom float argument. Exactly 3 arguments.
        let _ = palace
            .store_memory(
                "SelfHealingEngine",
                "autonomic_cycle",
                "Completed diagnostic + repair pass with Arbiter gating"
            )
            .await;
    }
}

use crate::memory::MemoryPalace;
use crate::orchestrator::Orchestrator;
use crate::system_monitor::SystemMonitor;
use serde_json::json;

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct NexusTask {
    pub payload: String,
    pub priority: u8,
}

pub struct MasterSupervisor;

impl MasterSupervisor {
    pub fn ignite(
        tx: broadcast::Sender<String>,
        client: reqwest::Client,
        api_key: String,
        orchestrator: Arc<Orchestrator>,
        resonance_meter: Arc<AtomicU32>,
        mut monitor: SystemMonitor,
        memory: Arc<Mutex<MemoryPalace>>,
    ) -> mpsc::Sender<NexusTask> {
        let (task_tx, mut task_rx) = mpsc::channel::<NexusTask>(32);

        tokio::spawn(async move {
            let _ = tx.send(
                json!({
                    "type": "LOG_EVENT",
                    "payload": { "level": "INFO", "message": "Master Supervisor ignited." }
                })
                .to_string(),
            );

            while let Some(task) = task_rx.recv().await {
                let _current_resonance = resonance_meter.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
                let vitals = monitor.get_vitals();

                // FIX: cpu_load is 0.0-1.0 (normalized over 4 cores in system_monitor.rs)
                // The old check `> 75.0` would NEVER trigger. Correct threshold is 0.75.
                if vitals.cpu_load > 0.75 || vitals.temperature > 68.0 {
                    println!(
                        "\x1b[33m>> [SUPERVISOR] Throttling â€” CPU: {:.0}% Temp: {:.1}Â°C\x1b[0m",
                        vitals.cpu_load * 100.0,
                        vitals.temperature
                    );
                    tokio::time::sleep(tokio::time::Duration::from_secs(15)).await;
                    continue;
                }

                let cl = client.clone();
                let ak = api_key.clone();
                let orch = orchestrator.clone();
                let mem = memory.clone();
                let task_tx_clone = tx.clone();

                tokio::spawn(async move {
                    let _ = crate::task_manager::send_task(
                        orch.agent.clone(),
                        &cl,
                        &ak,
                        &task.payload,
                        mem,
                        task_tx_clone,
                    )
                    .await;
                });
            }
        });

        task_tx
    }
}


--- PATH: src/system_monitor.rs ---

use sysinfo::{System, Components};

pub struct Vitals {
    pub ram_gb: f64,
    pub total_ram_gb: f64,
    pub temperature: f32,
    pub cpu_load: f32,
}

pub struct SystemMonitor {
    sys: System,
}

impl SystemMonitor {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        let mut sys = System::new_all();
        sys.refresh_all();
        Self { sys }
    }

    pub fn get_vitals(&mut self) -> Vitals {
        // Refresh system state
        self.sys.refresh_memory();
        self.sys.refresh_cpu_all();

        let total_mem = self.sys.total_memory() as f64 / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0;
        let used_mem = self.sys.used_memory() as f64 / 1024.0 / 1024.0 / 1024.0;
        
        // v0.31+ Thermal API: Components is now a separate refreshed list
        let components = Components::new_with_refreshed_list();
        let temp = components.iter()
            .find(|c| c.label().contains("CPU") || c.label().contains("Package"))
            .map(|c| c.temperature().unwrap_or(0.0))
            .unwrap_or(0.0);

        let load = self.sys.global_cpu_usage() / 100.0;

        Vitals {
            ram_gb: used_mem,
            total_ram_gb: total_mem,
            temperature: temp,
            cpu_load: load,
        }
    }
}

--- PATH: src/server.rs ---

use crate::task_manager;
use axum::{
    extract::{ws::{Message, WebSocket, WebSocketUpgrade}, Query, State},
    http::{header, StatusCode, Uri},
    response::IntoResponse,
    routing::{get, post},
    Json, Router,
};
use rust_embed::RustEmbed;
use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
use serde_json::json;
use std::sync::Arc;
use tokio::sync::Mutex;
use tower_http::cors::CorsLayer;

#[derive(RustEmbed)]
#[folder = "ui/dist/"]
struct Assets;

pub struct AppState {
    pub client: reqwest::Client,
    pub monitor: Mutex<crate::system_monitor::SystemMonitor>,
    pub agent: Arc<crate::neural_agent::MicroAgent>,
    pub orchestrator: Arc<crate::orchestrator::Orchestrator>,
    pub memory: Arc<Mutex<crate::memory::MemoryPalace>>,
    pub api_key: String,
    pub current_resonance: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32>,
    pub tx: tokio::sync::broadcast::Sender<String>,
    pub scheduler_tx: tokio::sync::mpsc::Sender<crate::scheduler::NexusTask>,
    pub arbiter: Arc<crate::arbiter_agent::ArbiterAgent>,
    pub local_llm: Arc<crate::local_llm::LocalLLM>,
    pub workspace_root: std::path::PathBuf,
}

pub async fn start_server(state: Arc<AppState>) {
    let app = build_router(state.clone());
    let listener = tokio::net::TcpListener::bind("0.0.0.0:3000").await.unwrap();
    println!("\x1b[38;2;0;255;255m>> [NEXUS] UPLINK ACTIVE: http://localhost:3000\x1b[0m");
    axum::serve(listener, app.into_make_service()).await.unwrap();
}

fn build_router(state: Arc<AppState>) -> Router {
    Router::new()
        .route("/api/fs/list", get(handle_fs_list))
        .route("/api/fs/read", get(handle_read_file))
        .route("/api/fs/write", post(handle_write_file))
        .route("/api/memories", get(handle_get_memories))
        .route("/api/task", post(handle_task))
        .route("/ws/nexus", get(ws_handler))
        .fallback(static_handler)
        .with_state(state)
        .layer(CorsLayer::permissive())
}

async fn ws_handler(ws: WebSocketUpgrade, State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>) -> impl IntoResponse {
    ws.on_upgrade(|socket| handle_socket(socket, state))
}

async fn handle_socket(mut socket: WebSocket, state: Arc<AppState>) {
    let mut rx = state.tx.subscribe();
    let mut heartbeat = tokio::time::interval(std::time::Duration::from_secs(2));
    loop {
        tokio::select! {
            Ok(msg) = rx.recv() => { 
                let json_msg = json!({"type": "NEURAL_STREAM", "payload": {"text": msg}}).to_string();
                if socket.send(Message::Text(json_msg.into())).await.is_err() { break; } 
            }
            _ = heartbeat.tick() => {
                let mut monitor = state.monitor.lock().await;
                let v = monitor.get_vitals();
                let payload = json!({"type": "telemetry", "payload": {
                    "temperature": v.temperature, 
                    "cpu_load": v.cpu_load, 
                    "ram_gb": v.ram_gb,
                    "total_ram_gb": v.total_ram_gb
                }});
                if socket.send(Message::Text(payload.to_string().into())).await.is_err() { break; }
            }
        }
    }
}

async fn handle_fs_list(Query(p): Query<ListParams>) -> impl IntoResponse { 
    let path = p.path.as_deref().unwrap_or("."); 
    let mut entries = Vec::new(); 
    if let Ok(rd) = std::fs::read_dir(path) { 
        for entry in rd.flatten() { 
            let name = entry.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string(); 
            if !name.starts_with('.') && name != "target" { 
                entries.push(json!({ "name": name, "path": entry.path().to_string_lossy(), "is_dir": entry.path().is_dir() })); 
            } 
        } 
    } 
    Json(entries) 
}

async fn handle_read_file(Query(p): Query<FileParams>) -> impl IntoResponse { 
    match std::fs::read_to_string(&p.path) { 
        Ok(c) => (StatusCode::OK, Json(json!({ "content": c }))).into_response(), 
        Err(_) => StatusCode::NOT_FOUND.into_response(), 
    } 
}

async fn handle_task(State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>, Json(payload): Json<TaskRequest>) -> impl IntoResponse { 
    let s = state.clone(); 
    tokio::spawn(async move { 
        task_manager::send_task(s.agent.clone(), &s.client, &s.api_key, &payload.directive, s.memory.clone(), s.tx.clone()).await; 
    }); 
    Json(json!({ "status": "QUEUED" })) 
}

async fn handle_get_memories(State(state): State<Arc<AppState>>) -> impl IntoResponse { 
    let palace = state.memory.lock().await; 
    match palace.fetch_all().await { 
        Ok(m) => (StatusCode::OK, Json(m)).into_response(), 
        Err(_) => StatusCode::NOT_FOUND.into_response() 
    } 
}

async fn static_handler(uri: Uri) -> impl IntoResponse { 
    let path = uri.path().trim_start_matches('/').to_string(); 
    let final_path = if path.is_empty() { "index.html".to_string() } else { path }; 
    match Assets::get(&final_path) { 
        Some(content) => ([(header::CONTENT_TYPE, mime_guess::from_path(&final_path).first_or_octet_stream().as_ref())], content.data).into_response(), 
        None => Assets::get("index.html").map(|c| ([(header::CONTENT_TYPE, "text/html")], c.data).into_response()).unwrap_or(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND.into_response()) 
    } 
}

// â”€â”€ ARMORED WRITE HANDLER â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
async fn handle_write_file(Json(p): Json<FileContent>) -> impl IntoResponse { 
    if p.path.starts_with("src/") || p.path.starts_with("lib/") || p.path == "Cargo.toml" {
        return StatusCode::FORBIDDEN;
    }
    match std::fs::write(&p.path, p.content) {
        Ok(_) => StatusCode::OK,
        Err(_) => StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
    }
}

#[derive(Deserialize)] pub struct TaskRequest { pub directive: String }
#[derive(Deserialize)] pub struct FileParams { pub path: String }
#[derive(Deserialize)] pub struct ListParams { pub path: Option<String> }
#[derive(Deserialize, Serialize)] pub struct FileContent { pub path: String, pub content: String }
